text:
Recommendation: Build the $490/year plan and offer it to the 40 requesters this week.
Why:
- Worst case is a margin leak: $98 per buyer who would have paid $588 anyway; $3,920/yr for the 40 (2.2% of $176,400 revenue); they prepay $19,600.
- The brand-cheapening fear is contradicted: customers asked for this themselves, and annual discounts are common in SaaS.
Risks and unknowns:
- Biggest risk is that churn is already low and mostly loyal, long-time customers just take the 17% cut with no real retention benefit.
- If most of the 40 would have paid $588 for annual anyway, the discount should be dropped.
Next steps:
1. Email the 40 by Oct 5 — success: 10+ switch by Oct 26 (25%) / stop if under 10: ask why before offering it to the other 260.
2. Get monthly churn by Oct 12 — success: 3%+, where the discount pays for itself / stop if under 3%: trim the offer to one month free instead of two.
3. Review Jan 5, 2027 — success: most adopters are new or at-risk customers / stop if most had 12+ months tenure: cut the discount for new signups.
